Definition
[Hodge-de Rham Laplacian] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0297 ↗ appa-def-exterior-derivative ↗ appa-def-formal-adjoint-exterior-derivative 1. Section A.4\group second-order-differential-operators

The Hodge-de Rham Laplacian, also called the Laplace-Beltrami operator, is the family of maps \[ -\Delta _d:\Omega ^p(\mathcal M^n)\to \Omega ^p(\mathcal M^n) \] defined by \[ -\Delta _d=d\delta +\delta d=d_{p-1}\delta _p+\delta _{p+1}d_p. \]
